notes: This catalog covers relevant European print publications outside the separately modeled DE, AT, CH and GB catalogs.
Country remains metadata on each entry; Europe is one catalog block rather than one catalog per country.
Selection is based on European relevance, reach, agenda-setting role, and viewpoint diversity. There are no country quotas.
Political orientation and radicality require attributed provenance; FSC does not infer orientation from nationality, language, constitutional questions, endorsements, or ownership alone.
Political fringe publications may be included when relevant; sparse viewpoints remain sparse rather than being filled artificially.
Print activity must be verified; reach and circulation are metadata, never exclusion thresholds.
research_notes: Priority-country lists guide research only and are not coverage requirements.
Candidate review is performed as one European set, not one approval cycle per country.
